cards.title: Collaborative Reading Amphitheatres
cards.description: Tiered upholstered amphitheater seating and ergonomic reading nooks designed to foster quiet immersion and group discussions.

cards.title: Cloud Digital Catalogs & Touch Terminals
cards.description: OPAC touch consoles enabling instant book lookup, cross-campus inter-library reservations, and digital eBook previews.

cards.title: Acoustic Focus & Individual Study Pods
cards.description: Sound-dampening single and dual study pods equipped with task lighting, universal power sockets, and ergonomic seating.

cards.title: Curved Modular Open Shelving Displays
cards.description: Double-sided powder-coated metal book stacks with beechwood end panels and child-height accessible curved perimeter display runs.

cards.title: Audio Recording & Audiobook Studio Rooms
cards.description: Soundproofed media listening booths and podcast recording stations designed for student storytelling and language acquisition.
